lines.gurmukhi: ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਏਕੁ ਤਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chamatakaar pragaas dah dis ek tah drisataaiaa ||
lines.translation: The brilliant flash of the One Lord is revealed to them - they behold Him in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai bhagat vachhal har birad aap banaaiaa ||4||3||6||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet; the Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way. ||4||3||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: thir sa(n)tan sohaag marai na jaavae ||
lines.translation: The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਸੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai grihi har naahu s sad hee raavae ||
lines.translation: She, whose home is blessed by her Husband Lord, enjoys Him forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: avinaasee avigat so prabh sadaa navatan niramalaa ||
lines.translation: God is eternal and immortal, forever young and immaculately pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah door sadaa hadoor thaakur dah dis pooran sad sadaa ||
lines.translation: He is not far away, He is ever-present; the Lord and Master fills the ten directions, forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: praanapat gat mat jaa te pri preet preetam bhaavae ||
lines.translation: He is the Lord of souls, the source of salvation and wisdom. The Love of my Dear Beloved is pleasing to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai thir sa(n)tan sohaag marai na jaavae ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks what the Guru's Teachings have led him to know. The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau raam bhataar taa kai anad ghanaa ||
lines.translation: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਵੰਤੀ ਸਾ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਬਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhava(n)tee saa naar sobhaa poor banaa ||
lines.translation: That soul-bride is happy, and her glory is perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan mahat kaliaan har jas sa(n)g surajan so prabhoo ||
lines.translation: She obtains honor, greatness and happiness, singing the Praise of the Lord. God, the Great Being, is always with her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਊਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sidh nav nidh tit grihi nahee oonaa sabh kachhoo ||
lines.translation: She attains total perfection and the nine treasures; her home lacks nothing. - everything is there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਾਨੀ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਬਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: madhur baanee pirahi maanee thir sohaag taa kaa banaa ||
lines.translation: Her speech is so sweet; she obeys her Beloved Lord; her marriage is permanent and everlasting.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai jaa ko raam bhataar taa kai anad ghanaa ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aau sakhee sa(n)t paas sevaa laageeai ||
lines.translation: Come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਸਉ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: peesau charan pakhaar aap tiaageeai ||
lines.translation: Let us grind their corn, wash their feet and so renounce our self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਆਪੁ ਨਹ ਜਾਣਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj aap mitai sa(n)taap aap nah jaanaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Let us shed our egos, and our troubles shall be removed; let us not display ourselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran gaheejai maan leejai kare so sukh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Let us take to His Sanctuary and obey Him, and be happy with whatever He does.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਾਗੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar daas daasee taj udaasee kar joR din rain jaageeai ||
lines.translation: Let us become the slaves of His slaves, and shed our sadness, and with our palms pressed together, remain wakeful day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai aau sakhee sa(n)t paas sevaa laageeai ||3||
lines.translation: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings; come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai masatak bhaag s sevaa laaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee pooran aas jinh saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who attains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has his desires fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har kai ra(n)g gobi(n)d simaran laagiaa ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord; remember the Lord of the Universe in meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam mohu vikaar doojaa sagal tinahi tiaagiaa ||
lines.translation: Doubt, emotional attachment, sin and duality - he renounces them all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man saa(n)t sahaj subhaau voothaa anad ma(n)gal gun gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Peace, poise and tranquility fill his mind, and he sings the Lord's Glorious Praises with joy and delight.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai jaa kai masatak bhaag s sevaa laaiaa ||4||4||7||
lines.translation: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: one who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service. ||4||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japa(n)tiaa kachh na kahai jamakaal ||
lines.translation: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Messenger of Death will have nothing to say to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak man tan sukhee hoi a(n)te milai gopaal ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the mind and body will be at peace, and in the end, you shall merge with the Lord of the world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: milau sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g mohi udhaar lehu ||
lines.translation: Let me join the Society of the Saints - save me, Lord!

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: binau karau kar joR har har naam dehu ||
lines.translation: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer: give me Your Name, O Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam maagau charan laagau maan tiaagau tumh daiaa ||
lines.translation: I beg for the Lord's Name, and fall at His feet; I renounce my self-conceit, by Your kindness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨ ਧਾਵਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: katahoo(n) na dhaavau saran paavau karunaa mai prabh kar maiaa ||
lines.translation: I shall not wander anywhere else, but take to Your Sanctuary. O God, embodiment of mercy, have mercy on me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗਥ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਨਉ ਏਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: samarath agath apaar niramal sunahu suaamee binau ehu ||
lines.translation: O all-powerful, indescribable, infinite and immaculate Lord Master, listen to this, my prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar joR naanak daan maagai janam maran nivaar lehu ||1||
lines.translation: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing: O Lord, let my cycle of birth and death come to an end. ||1||
